prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design an exceptionally crafted desktop security-response platform mockup for Wisesama. COMPOSITION C, "Briefing to action": a design presentation board containing TWO FULL DESKTOP APP SCREENSHOTS stacked vertically, DARK MODE top and the exact corresponding LIGHT MODE bottom. Each screenshot 1440x800 proportions, total board about 1600x1900, small outside labels "C — Briefing to action", "Dark", "Light", no devices.
Attached screenshot is the existing Wisesama brand reference ONLY: preserve geometric purple logo/wordmark, clean Satoshi body and strong Clash Display heading feel, purple/pink identity. Do not reuse crypto content, marketing hero, unsupported numbers or glows.
Layout: narrow 185px left sidebar with mark, workspace "Acme", nav "Today" selected, "Response inbox" count 3, "Projects", "Notifications", settings bottom. Upper main "Today’s security briefing" at 32px, date "Wednesday, 4 November", small "Demo workspace" and "Import inventory" button. Below quiet tabs "Relevant to you" selected, "All briefings", "Following". Horizontal source-health bar "GitHub Advisories · CISA KEV · OSV" with plain "Last checked 8 min ago" no unjustified security assurances.
Main region asymmetric 70/30 editorial layout. Left is a single expanded vulnerability briefing with large title "Brotli decoder memory corruption", code CVE-2026-111497, readable independent severity "High" and exploitation "Unknown" badges. Section "What happened" with 2 concise lines describing "Malformed compressed data can corrupt memory in affected runtimes. Review the vendor advisory for applicability." Bold inline match statement with purple background "Matches production-api · Node.js 22.23.3". Below a fine three-column information strip "Installed 22.23.3", "Fixed release 22.23.4", "Evidence Imported inventory". "What to do" ordered 3 steps "Confirm the deployed runtime" "Upgrade and redeploy" "Record the new version". Purple primary button "Open response", subtle link "Read vendor advisory ↗". Bottom "Guidance history" slim horizontal dated milestones, no graphs.
Below expanded briefing, one compact next briefing row "PHP runtime remote code execution" "CVE-2026-109618" "Matches legacy-checkout", status "Needs assessment".
Right narrow context rail: heading "Your response" text "3 findings need attention" with small list production-api / Open; legacy-checkout / Investigating. Next section "Inventory coverage" text "2 projects imported" "Deployment verification pending". Small outlined action "Manage projects". Next section "Delivery" Email "Not enabled", button "Set up alerts". Demonstration footnote avoids asserting actual live data.
Dark palette #0c0c11 ground, #17151e surfaces, warm offwhite text, lavender gray secondary, #7c3aed and sparse #e6007a. Light palette #faf9fc ground, white surfaces, dark ink text, deep purple links/primary and restrained pale lavender highlighted match. Excellent legibility, deliberate typographic rhythm, flat hairline separation and 10px corner subtle inset controls. No generic KPI cards, no icon card grid, no oversized display marketing hero, no photos, no gradients or cyberpunk glow. Full usable product screenshots with crisp text and all controls visible.
